subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Mercedes-Benz engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the M256 across all six model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The M256 is fitted across five modern Mercedes-Benz model lines, spanning sports cars, executive saloons, and large SUVs.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain, bearings, gaskets, and 48V electrical system components as standard on every rebuild.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: Balance shaft module failure and piston/bearing defects have been documented, which can lead to catastrophic engine damage. We inspect these thoroughly as standard during every rebuild.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page — they'll be added once a documented set of completed M256 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.
